title: Interior Designer + Operations Executive
description:
**Job Title:** Interior Designer \+ Operations Executive  
**Location:** South Bopal, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**About Neo Homes**  
Neo Homes is an interior design and modular furniture company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. We're looking for a passionate Design Intern to join our growing team and gain hands\-on experience in residential and commercial interior design projects.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a **creative, confident and well\-organized Interior Designer \+ Operations Executive** to join our team. The role involves a combination of **interior/modular furniture design, client handling, showroom management and day\-to\-day operations**.

The candidate should be comfortable working with clients, understanding their requirements, taking site measurements, preparing 2D/3D designs and drawings, coordinating with the execution team, and ensuring smooth project and showroom operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle clients visiting the showroom.
* Take accurate **site measurements** and understand site conditions.
* Prepare **2D layouts, plans, elevations and detailed drawings**.
* Create **3D designs and presentations** as per client requirements.
* Work proficiently with **AutoCAD and relevant 3D design software**.
* Develop designs based on space, functionality, aesthetics and client requirements.
* Discuss designs with clients and make revisions based on their feedback.
* Prepare drawings and details required for production and execution.
* Coordinate with clients, production teams, vendors, contractors and installation teams.
* Coordinate site visits, measurements, deliveries and installations.
* Handle day\-to\-day **showroom and operational activities**.

Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of **AutoCAD \& Photoshop**
* Good knowledge of **2D \& 3D designing**
* Ability to take accurate **site measurements**
* Understanding of modular furniture and interior execution
* Knowledge of furniture layouts, materials, finishes and hardware
* Good client communication and presentation skills
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously
* Willingness to travel for site visits when required
* Attention to detail and ability to work independently

Qualification \& Experience

* Diploma/Degree in **Interior Design, Architecture, Furniture Design or a related field**
* 1–3 years of relevant experience preferred
* Experience in **modular kitchens, wardrobes, furniture or interior execution** will be an advantage.
* Experience in client handling and showroom sales will be an added advantage.

**How to Apply:**  
Interested candidates can apply by sending their **CV/Resume** to:  
**Email:** neohomesgujarat@gmail.com  
**Phone / WhatsApp:** 7990762933

title: ReactJS TL
description:
Title : ReactJS TL (6\+Years)  
Location : Ahmedabad \| On\-Site

**Primary Responsibilities**  
**Lead a team of front\-end developers in delivering scalable and maintainable web applications using React.js.**  
Own the architecture and technical decisions for complex UI features and front\-end systems.  
**Mentor team members, conduct code reviews, and enforce development best practices.**  
Translate product requirements into technical specifications and timelines.  
**Collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, DevOps, and QA to ensure end\-to\-end delivery.**  
Drive performance optimization, cross\-browser compatibility, and responsive design.  
**Manage task allocation, sprint planning, and ensure timely delivery of features.**  
Ensure a high standard of UI/UX consistency and quality across the product.

**Technical Requirements**  
**6\+ years of hands\-on experience with React.js, including Hooks, Context API, and Redux.**  
Strong foundation in JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS/SASS.  
**Solid experience in designing component libraries, design systems, and atomic design structures.**  
Familiarity with Next.js, Server\-Side Rendering (SSR), and static site generation.  
**Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and JSON data handling.**  
Experience working with Webpack, Babel, and front\-end build optimization.  
**Expertise in unit testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library) and integration testing.**  
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, code versioning tools like Git, and tools like ESLint, Prettier.  
**Experience deploying and scaling front\-end applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).**  
Bonus: Exposure to micro frontends, performance profiling tools, and A/B testing frameworks.

**Leadership \& Communication**  
**Proven experience leading a front\-end or full\-stack development team.**  
Ability to set coding standards, development workflows, and agile best practices.  
**Excellent communication skills for interfacing with clients, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams.**  
Strong problem\-solving skills and decision\-making under tight timelines.

**Experience**  
**Minimum Years of Experience: 6–7 years total (at least 2 years in a leadership role)**  
Relevant Industry Experience: Web application development using React.js in large\-scale projects

**Require Client Communication:** Yes

Benefits:
